title: Co-rotating Vortices on Surfaces of Variable Negative Curvature: Hamiltonian Structure and Curvature-Induced Drift
summary: Vortices in fluids and superfluids are fundamental to phenomena ranging from Bose-Einstein condensates and superfluid films to neutron stars and hydrodynamic micro-rotors, where background geometry often plays an important role. Curvature can induce vortex motion distinct from planar domains. We study Hamiltonian vortex motion on a catenoid, a minimal surface of variable negative curvature, and derive explicit equations of motion and conserved quantities for co-rotating vortex pairs.
